title: Arithmetic Unitarity I: Where the Riemann Hypothesis Lives in the Scaling Flow
summary: By Weil's criterion the Riemann Hypothesis (RH) is equivalent to positivity of the Hermitian form Q of the explicit formula. We show that this is the same as unitarity (absence of negative-norm "ghost" directions) of the logarithmic scaling flow on test functions; the negative index of Q equals the number of zeros off the critical line. This volume does not prove RH. It reformulates and localizes this single obstruction: along the de Bruijn-Newman heat flow; in function-field and Iwasawa models, where positivity is a theorem; as an action principle whose stationary points are closed orbits;…

review.reason: Reformulates the Riemann Hypothesis as unitarity of a logarithmic scaling flow.
